_comment: Model registry for hf_run.py. Endpoints verified 2026-09-20 against the
Higgsfield's own llms.txt says the model catalog is discovered at
console.higgsfield.ai and that /docs/openapi.json is SUPPLEMENTARY, not
authoritative. That is not a formality: openapi.json lists Kling at
v2.5-turbo while the live model page documents v3.0-turbo, and it lists
soul at a path one segment shorter than the quickstart uses. So an entry
here is a cached answer, not a guarantee. `hf_run.py doctor` re-checks
credentials for free; a 404 on submit means the path moved and this file
needs an edit, not that the account lacks access.
rate_unit: per_second bills duration, per_image bills variants.
verified: where the endpoint string came from.

soul.verified: docs quickstart 2026-09-20; openapi.json disagrees (/higgsfield-ai/soul/standard). If this 404s, try that.
soul.notes: Cheapest path to a still. This is the image-first workflow's workhorse.

grok-image.notes: Generate and edit. Rate is the catalog image rate and is not separately confirmed for this model. Edit mode: pass --param image_urls='["<url from upload>"]' (up to 10 refs). quality low|medium.

kling3-turbo-t2v.notes: Text to video. No start frame.

kling3-turbo-i2v.notes: Start frame required. This is the image-first workflow's second half: generate a still, upload it, animate it.

wan3-ref2v.notes: Reference to video. Takes an uploaded file or a link.
